notes: §2002:8.3.1.2.5.3 GR6 (partial witness): at runtime LOW-VALUE is ordinal 1 of its class's program collating sequence, so under AL/NAL it is B in alphanumeric contexts (working-storage and CD record fields, CHAR(1), a relation) and C in national ones; the run at --std 2002 matched. Only the runtime paragraph and the national/alphanumeric paragraph of GR6 are pinned; the compile-time/SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph and the LC_COLLATE paragraph have no leg in this case.
